Disputed terminology proposal: "افادیت کے لحاظ سے درجہ بندی" for "Classification by functionality" (key_terms block, concept file CON:GICT-300-1-7, topic-03 headings/activity/CYU, assessment summary). "افادیت" denotes utility/usefulness, while the axis distinguishes computers by the kind of signals they process (analog/digital/hybrid); the topic body disambiguates ("اس قسم کے سگنلز کے لحاظ سے") but as a banked heading term the label is disputable - "فنکشن کے لحاظ سے درجہ بندی" or "عمل کے لحاظ سے درجہ بندی" would track the English more closely. The concept file asks G5 to confirm each authored label: 10 of 12 are confirmed; this one is referred to the owner. Banking any of the 12 remains the owner action either way.

Inconsistent shorthand: the embedded-computer class appears as the bare adjective "اندرونی" in list positions (topic-03.mdx description front-matter, activity step 2, summary; unit-assessment.mdx unit summary) while the full label "اندرونی جڑا ہوا کمپیوٹر" is used at first definition and in the key_terms block. The bare adjective ("internal") is weaker; prefer the full label (or "ایمبیڈڈ کمپیوٹر") in the enumerations.
